name: window-tiler
title: Window Tiler
description: Tile windows into grid, column, row, main-stack and spiral layouts, with include and exclude lists.
author: mearman

commands.name: tile-current-app
commands.title: Tile App
commands.description: Tile every window of the frontmost application in the layout chosen in preferences.

commands.name: tile-desktop
commands.title: Tile Windows
commands.description: Tile every window on the active desktop in the layout chosen in preferences.

commands.name: manage-lists
commands.title: Tiling Lists
commands.description: Choose which applications are always left alone and, optionally, which are the only ones tiled.

commands.name: tile-desktop-grid
commands.title: Tile Windows: Grid
commands.description: Tile every window on the active desktop as Grid, whatever the layout preference says.

commands.name: tile-desktop-columns
commands.title: Tile Windows: Columns
commands.description: Tile every window on the active desktop as Columns, whatever the layout preference says.

commands.name: tile-desktop-rows
commands.title: Tile Windows: Rows
commands.description: Tile every window on the active desktop as Rows, whatever the layout preference says.

commands.name: tile-desktop-main-stack
commands.title: Tile Windows: Main + Stack
commands.description: Tile every window on the active desktop as Main and Stack, whatever the layout preference says.

commands.name: tile-desktop-spiral
commands.title: Tile Windows: Spiral
commands.description: Tile every window on the active desktop as Spiral, whatever the layout preference says.

commands.name: tile-current-app-grid
commands.title: Tile App: Grid
commands.description: Tile every window of the frontmost application as Grid, whatever the layout preference says.

commands.name: tile-current-app-columns
commands.title: Tile App: Columns
commands.description: Tile every window of the frontmost application as Columns, whatever the layout preference says.

commands.name: tile-current-app-rows
commands.title: Tile App: Rows
commands.description: Tile every window of the frontmost application as Rows, whatever the layout preference says.

commands.name: tile-current-app-main-stack
commands.title: Tile App: Main + Stack
commands.description: Tile every window of the frontmost application as Main and Stack, whatever the layout preference says.

commands.name: tile-current-app-spiral
commands.title: Tile App: Spiral
commands.description: Tile every window of the frontmost application as Spiral, whatever the layout preference says.

commands.name: move-window-forward
commands.title: Move Window Forward
commands.description: Swap the focused window with the next one in the current layout.

commands.name: move-window-back
commands.title: Move Window Back
commands.description: Swap the focused window with the previous one in the current layout.

commands.name: move-window-start
commands.title: Move Window to Start
commands.description: Move the focused window to the first slot in the current layout, shifting the others along.

commands.name: move-window-end
commands.title: Move Window to End
commands.description: Move the focused window to the last slot in the current layout, shifting the others back.

commands.name: move-window-left
commands.title: Move Window Left
commands.description: Swap the focused window with the window to its left in the current layout.

commands.name: move-window-right
commands.title: Move Window Right
commands.description: Swap the focused window with the window to its right in the current layout.

commands.name: move-window-up
commands.title: Move Window Up
commands.description: Swap the focused window with the window above it in the current layout.

commands.name: move-window-down
commands.title: Move Window Down
commands.description: Swap the focused window with the window below it in the current layout.

commands.name: move-window
commands.title: Move Window
commands.description: Move the focused window within the current layout by choosing a direction or an order change.

commands.name: rotate-windows-forward
commands.title: Rotate Windows Forward
commands.description: Move every window one slot forward in the current layout, the last to the first.

commands.name: rotate-windows-back
commands.title: Rotate Windows Back
commands.description: Move every window one slot back in the current layout, the first to the last.

preferences.name: windowOrder
preferences.title: Window Order
preferences.description: Which window goes in which layout slot. Nearest keeps windows close to where they are; Reading Order goes top to bottom then left to right; Active First puts the focused window in the first slot (the main slot in Main + Stack); App Priority follows the order of the include list.

preferences.name: gap
preferences.title: Gap
preferences.description: Space between windows and around the screen edge, in the unit below. Negative values make neighbouring windows overlap; the screen edge is never pushed outwards.

preferences.name: gapUnit
preferences.title: Gap Unit
preferences.description: What the gap is measured in. Percentages apply per axis: of each window's own width or height, or of the screen's width or height.

preferences.name: gapAtEdge
preferences.title: Gap Placement
preferences.label: Leave a gap at the screen edge
preferences.description: Apply the gap between windows and the edge of the screen.

preferences.name: gapBetween
preferences.label: Leave a gap between windows
preferences.description: Apply the gap between neighbouring windows. Turn off to keep windows flush and only inset from the screen edge.
preferences.title: Gap Placement

preferences.name: moveDuration
preferences.title: Move Duration
preferences.description: Milliseconds windows take to slide to their new position. 0 moves them instantly. Must be a non-negative number.

preferences.name: resizeDuration
preferences.title: Resize Duration
preferences.description: Milliseconds windows take to change size. 0 resizes them instantly. Must be a non-negative number.
